identity.account: Derived from authenticated native membership, never from a PABX response
identity.logical_tenant: Persisted expected_tenant; unchanged by diagnosis or import
identity.accountcode: Strict existing identity contract unless a SuperAdmin explicitly authorizes an Account-local mapping
identity.mapping: Server stamps Account, logical tenant, author and time; copied, stale and malformed mappings are rejected
identity.cdr_identity: Mapping explicitly declares whether its configured CDR field contains tenant or accountcode; never inferred
identity.extension: Human SIP/history extension remains distinct from technical SIP identity

capabilities.implementation: durable ingestor/reconciler exist; real ingress/signature contract missing

execution_rules: No PABX endpoint invented; no provider requests executed by this delivery
accepted_by_gateway is not confirmed_by_pabx; unknown is not retried as success
Existing event idempotency is Account/provider/event plus payload digest
Sync imports CDR transactionally with bounded pages and wall-clock budget; it is not resource publication
Critical configuration approval will use the native approval Catalog; no policy is activated here
external_dependencies: Real provider capabilities and response schemas
Signed callback verification and replay window

facts: Native authentication, public-DNS SSRF protection, TLS verification and bounded response sizes already exist.
Scope diagnostics check the authorized tenant/accountcode mapping and retain external_homologation pending.
The native settings endpoint independently rejects account administrators who are not SuperAdmin.
Native synchronization imports CDR history; it does not publish queue/URA/audio configuration.
